scopeDescription:
Electrical Installation Works – Oxygen Pump Supply

Electrical Supply Installation
Supply and install a 230V electrical supply from the existing three-phase distribution panel upstairs to provide power for the downstairs oxygen pump.
Install a toggle switch upstairs to control the oxygen pump.
Supply and install PVC trunking from the distribution panel to the drop ceiling.
Supply and install trunking from the pilot light switch location to the ceiling.
Supply and install ECC wire from the distribution panel, through the drop ceiling, to the pilot light switch.
Drill through the wall as required to facilitate routing of the electrical supply from the pilot light switch to the downstairs outlet.
Supply and install conduit from the upstairs level to the downstairs outlet.
Pull and install the required wiring through the conduit.

Termination and Connections
Terminate conductors at the distribution panel.
Make up and connect the pilot light switch.
Make up and connect the downstairs power outlet.
Downsize existing breaker(s) within the distribution panel as required to create space for the new circuit.
Supply and install 1 × 30A/30A Quad Duplex breaker to accommodate the new electrical supply.
